baseline_observations: index-START.html script block is empty, meaning clock hands do not rotate and stay frozen horizontally.
The page relies entirely on CSS 2D transforms (transform: rotate(...), transform-origin: 100%) without feature detection.
If CSS transforms are unsupported, hands render broken across center with no readable fallback text or digital alternative.
External background image request to unsplash.it introduces external dependency.
decision: Implement analog clock hands rotation logic; implement CSS @supports and JS feature detection for CSS transforms; add semantic digital fallback readout (#clock-fallback); add automated Playwright regression test tests/course/r57-t035.mjs verifying both feature-present (analog rotation) and feature-absent (stubbed transform unsupported with digital fallback) execution paths.
